messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks"
set: ["dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks", "do not take more than prescribed dose", "do not take more than recommended dose", "dose increase no more often than once a week", "4 weeks after each dose change", "taking more than recommended dose does not increase effectiveness", "once every evening", "if more than 4 days have passed, skip the missed dose", "do not take more than prescribed", "do not take more than recommended", "no more often than once a week", "taking more than your recommended dose will not make this medicine more effective", "4 weeks after starting", "87% after 4 weeks", "40 mg every 12 weeks", "increased risk of broken bone with long-term use or more than once per day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
